meta.name: Nepal Work Atlas Simplified Analytical Minimalism
meta.description: A three-workspace, graph-first analytical research interface with Nepal-only data and progressive disclosure.
source_references: Nepal Work Atlas simplified UX preview

primary.role: primary foreground and active analytical emphasis

neutral.usage: surface hierarchy, muted labels, primary text

color.contrast_strategy: high-contrast light text on near-black surfaces; color supplements labels and exact values

font_families.heading: system-ui sans-serif
font_families.mono: SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: Neutral system sans for interface text; monospace only for compact evidence metadata and numeric context.

spacing.section_rhythm: one primary workspace at a time with 14-28px internal spacing

layout.grid_system: single centered 1400px analytical canvas with workspace and local grids

elevation.depth_cues: border contrast and surface value; shadow only for tooltip/overlay

iconography.style: minimal line marks or text glyphs
iconography.preferred_set: no dependency; inline SVG only when necessary

motion.entrance_pattern: 8px translate plus autoAlpha for workspace/inspector continuity
motion.exit_pattern: direct replacement or short opacity change
motion.philosophy: minimal functional orientation; no scroll spectacle

components.button_style: transparent rectangular controls with thin borders where needed
components.input_style: near-black 1px bordered inputs with visible focus
components.card_style: flat panels only where grouping needs a surface
components.navigation_pattern: three primary workspace tabs; Vacancies has Jobs, Geography, Timeline, Sources secondary tabs
components.modal_style: inline inspector rather than centered modal
components.list_style: dense evidence tables with tabular values
components.component_notes: One primary task is visible at a time; methods and cross-dataset caveats live in Research.

visual_language.complexity: minimal chrome with controlled data density
visual_language.whitespace_usage: tight inside controls and deliberate around the active workspace

composition.hierarchy_method: workspace selection, scale contrast, and spatial isolation
composition.flow_direction: workspace switch rather than one long multi-section dashboard
composition.grouping_strategy: tabs, thin rules, alignment, and proximity
composition.negative_space_role: separates active task from supporting context

imagery.graphic_elements: treemap rectangles, bars, timelines, numeric tables

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: state what is unknown or absent without implying zero

overview.fallback_strategy: show final state immediately under reduced motion

canvas_drawings.description: DOM treemap retained for keyboard accessibility and direct interaction

visual_effects.composite_notes: GSAP is limited to functional workspace, list, inspector, treemap layer, and selection transitions. No ambient loops, parallax, glow, or scroll choreography.
